sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Stone circle near Amesbury, Wiltshire, run by English Heritage.

access.opening: Within published opening hours; tickets are valid all day.
access.tickets: Book online by midnight the day before for the discounted price; on-the-day tickets are full price. Prices shown only in the booking tool.

sites.name: Avebury stone circle
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Stone circle and henge in the Avebury World Heritage Site, National Trust.

access.opening: Stone circle open dawn to dusk.
access.tickets: Stone circle free; car park £8 (about A$15.21 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) all day or £5 after 3pm; guided stone circle tours £6 adult.
